name: Vendor outreach campaign
description: Personalised outbound email to a recordset of vendors. Drafts via OpenHuman, you review each draft in /approvals before send, capped at 20/day. Inbound replies route back into the same campaign for triage.

proposed_workflows.name: Vendor outreach — outbound batch
proposed_workflows.description: Daily 9am: for each uncontacted vendor in the sheet, draft a personalised email and queue for approval.

config.prompt: Draft a short, personalised outreach email to {{record.name}} at {{record.email}}. Reference what they do (column `company` if present) and our offer. Keep it under 120 words. Sign off as the user. Use composio.GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL with the user's connected Gmail to send — the runtime will intercept and queue for approval, do not skip the call.

rationale_at_seed: for_each over the Vendors sheet filtered to uncontacted rows; campaign throttle gates to 20/day.
DraftAndApprove on the campaign intercepts the gmail send — every draft lands in /approvals.
agent_prompt uses {{record.name}} + {{record.email}} templating to personalise per row.

proposed_workflows.name: Vendor outreach — reply handler
proposed_workflows.description: When a vendor replies (Gmail), classify intent and either draft a follow-up (queued for approval) or mark the row as not_interested.

config.prompt: A new Gmail message arrived: {{trigger.payload}}. If it's a reply to an outreach we sent: classify intent (interested / not_interested / out_of_office). If interested, draft a short follow-up via composio.GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL (the runtime queues it for approval). If not_interested, no action needed. If unrelated to outreach, no action.

rationale_at_seed: Composio Gmail trigger fires on every new message — the agent gates on whether it's a reply to outreach.
Follow-up sends route through the same DraftAndApprove intercept so the user sees the reply draft in /approvals.
No status write-back to the sheet in this MVP; F4-17 follow-up adds a closed-loop update.
Vendor outreach is the canonical Phase 4 campaign — recordset + throttle + draft-and-approve all together.
Default binding is Google Sheets so the user can ship without Attio; swap to Attio in the campaign edit flow.
Throttle 20/day matches the cadence locked in the 2026-05-26 grill.
Two sub-workflows (outbound + reply handler). A daily digest is a sensible add-on but lives in the F4-17 follow-up template if user demand surfaces.
